HomeFacilities & Services

23 facilities and services, grouped by what you came for

From walk-in outpatient care and emergency treatment to diagnostics, specialist clinics, therapy and home nursing — all available at Negombo Road, Ja-Ela.

Always open

24-Hour Services

The core of the hospital. Outpatient care, medicines, tests and emergency treatment are available at any hour, every day.

  • 24 Hour OPD

    Outpatient consultations available day and night, no appointment required.

  • 24 Hour Pharmacy

    Prescribed medicines dispensed on site around the clock.

  • 24 Hour Laboratory

    Routine and urgent investigations processed at any hour.

  • Emergency Treatment Unit

    Immediate assessment and stabilisation for urgent conditions.

  • Ambulance Services

    Patient transport to and from the hospital when needed.

Diagnostics

On-site imaging so investigations and results stay in one place.

  • Digital X-Ray

    Fast digital radiography with same-visit reporting.

  • Ultrasound Scanning

    Abdominal, obstetric and general ultrasound scanning.

  • 2D Echo

    Echocardiography for cardiac assessment.

Treatment

Ongoing and procedural care delivered by trained nursing and medical staff.

  • Chemotherapy

    Supervised chemotherapy administration in a monitored setting.

  • Wound Dressing and Suturing

    Wound cleaning, dressing and suturing, including diabetic wound care.

  • Preliminary Care Unit

    First-line care and observation before admission or referral.

Specialist Care

Consultant-led clinics for focused assessment and treatment.

  • Specialist Consultation Services

    Consultant sessions across a range of disciplines.

  • Eye Clinic

    Eye examinations, screening and follow-up care.

  • Cataract Eye Surgery

    Cataract surgery under consultant eye surgeon care.

  • Dental Clinic

    Routine dental examination and treatment.

Rehabilitation & Therapy

Recovery, mobility, hearing and communication support.

  • Physiotherapy Services

    Rehabilitation for injury, pain and post-operative recovery.

  • Audiology Services

    Hearing assessment and related support.

  • Speech and Language Therapy

    Assessment and therapy for speech and language needs.

Patient Support

Care that continues beyond the consultation room — at the ward and at home.

  • Fully Air-Conditioned Admission Rooms

    Comfortable air-conditioned rooms for inward patients.

  • Home Nursing Visits

    Trained nursing care delivered at the patient’s home.

  • Physiological Counselling

    Counselling support as listed by the hospital.

  • Counselling Services

    Confidential counselling for patients and families.

  • Ambulance Services

    Emergency and non-emergency patient transport.

Other Facilities

Practical details that make a hospital visit easier.

  • Spacious Parking Area

    On-site parking for patients and visitors.
